other_mijikenda: Duruma: todza (Pakia App. VI); also Swahili

teaser.en: Its seeds twist into tangles and drill into socks and skin; its stems thatch Digo houses.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake hujisokota kuwa mafundo na kutoboa soksi na ngozi; mashina yake huezeka nyumba za Wadigo.
teaser.dg: Tembeze zinadzisokota na kutsanganyikana, na zinainjira ndani ya soksi na ngozi; mihiye nkuhumirwa kuezeka nyumba za Adigo.

summary.en: Nguji is spear grass, a tufted grass whose dark, twisted awns knot together and whose sharp seeds stick in clothing. Pakia lists it among the grasses the Digo use in house building.
summary.sw: Nguji ni *spear grass*, nyasi inayoota kwa vishungi ambayo vikonyo vyake virefu vyeusi vilivyosokotwa hujifunga pamoja na mbegu zake kali hunasa kwenye nguo. Pakia anaiorodhesha miongoni mwa nyasi ambazo Wadigo hutumia katika ujenzi wa nyumba.
summary.dg: Nguji (kpwa Chingereza *spear grass*) ni nyasi inayomera mabunda, yenye nyere nyire za rangi ya jiza zinazodzisokota na kufungana, na tembe zenye ntsa kali zinazogbwira nguwo. Pakia anaiandika kahi ya nyasi ambazo Adigo nkuzihumira kudzengera nyumba.

about.en:
*Nguji* is a tufted perennial grass, usually knee- to waist-high, with flattened leaf sheaths and narrow leaves. Its flower spikes end in long, dark brown awns that twist together when dry, so a ripe clump looks matted and tangled.

Each seed has a sharp, hard point and a spiralling awn that coils and uncoils with moisture, screwing the seed into the ground, or into socks, wool and skin.
about.sw:
*Nguji* ni nyasi ya kudumu inayoota kwa vishungi, kwa kawaida ya kimo cha goti hadi kiuno, yenye ala za majani zilizobapa na majani membamba. Vishada vyake vya maua huishia kwa vikonyo virefu vya rangi ya kahawia iliyokolea vinavyojisokota pamoja vikikauka, kwa hiyo kishungi kilichokomaa huonekana kimesongamana na kutatanika.

Kila mbegu ina ncha kali na ngumu na kikonyo kinachojizungusha, ambacho hujikunja na kujikunjua kwa unyevu, kikiisokota mbegu ardhini, au ndani ya soksi, sufu na ngozi.
about.dg:
*Nguji* ni nyasi inayomera mabunda na inakala na moyo kpwa miaka minji. Kpwa kawaida urewe ni kula magotini hadi chununi. Seemu za photsi za makodza, zinazozunguluka muhi, ni sambamba, na makodza ni membamba. Vitswavye vya maruwa vinamala na nyere nyire za rangi ya dongo ya jiza, zinazodzisokota phamwenga zichiuma, kpwa hivyo bunda ririroivwa rinaonekana dza rikafungana na kutsanganyikana.

Chila tembe ina ntsa kali ngumu na nyere inayodzizunguluka, inayodzilinga na kudzikundzula kulunga jeke-jeke. Kpwa njira ihi tembe inadziinjiza tsini dza skrubu, au ndani ya soksi, nyoya za ng'ondzi na ngozi.

where.en: It grows on open grassland, bush clearings, roadsides and dry, stony slopes across the tropics, and is common on the coastal plain.
where.sw: Huota nyikani wazi, kwenye maeneo yaliyosafishwa vichakani, kando ya barabara na kwenye miteremko mikavu yenye mawe kote katika nchi za joto, na ni ya kawaida katika nyanda za pwani.
where.dg: Inamera nyasini, phatu pha weruni phariphotemwa, kanda-kanda ya njira na kpwenye miteremuko mikavu ya mawe, kpwenye tsi za dzoho za dunia yosi; ni ya kawaida kpwenye tsi sambamba ya pwani.

uses.en: Pakia names *Heteropogon contortus* among the grasses the Digo use for house building, alongside *Hyparrhenia* and *Cyperus exaltatus*; the stems serve as thatch. Young growth is good grazing before the seeds form.
uses.sw: Pakia anataja *Heteropogon contortus* miongoni mwa nyasi ambazo Wadigo hutumia kujenga nyumba, pamoja na *Hyparrhenia* na *Cyperus exaltatus*; mashina yake hutumika kuezekea. Machipukizi machanga ni malisho mazuri kabla mbegu hazijatokea.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika *Heteropogon contortus* kahi ya nyasi ambazo Adigo nkuzihumira kudzengera nyumba, phamwenga na *Hyparrhenia* na *Cyperus exaltatus*; mihiye nkuhumirwa kuezeka. Ichiri mphya, kabla ya tembe kutuluka, ni chakurya chinono cha mifugo.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *nguji* and *todza*; *todza* is shared with Duruma and Swahili. *Todza* is also the name of blackjack (*Bidens pilosa*), another plant with clinging seeds. Pakia's name-prefix table lists both *nguji* and *todza* under blackjack, so which plant each name belongs to needs checking. In English it is spear grass or tanglehead.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti majina mawili ya Kidigo, *nguji* na *todza*; *todza* linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. *Todza* pia ni jina la kishonanguo (*Bidens pilosa*), mmea mwingine wenye mbegu zinazonata. Jedwali la viambishi vya majina la Pakia linaorodhesha *nguji* na *todza* yote chini ya kishonanguo, kwa hiyo jina lipi ni la mmea upi linahitaji kuthibitishwa. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *spear grass* au *tanglehead*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *nguji* na *todza*; *todza* rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma na Chiswahili. *Todza* piya ni dzina ra mmea wanjina (*Bidens pilosa*, kpwa Chingereza *blackjack*) wenye tembe zinazogbwira. Orodha ya Pakia ya *prefix* za madzina inaika *nguji* na *todza* vyosi photsi ya *Bidens pilosa*, kpwa hivyo ni lazima kulola tsona ni dzina riphi ra mmea uphi. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *spear grass* au *tanglehead*.
